history.summary: SATRA/THAN (Vaishnavite monastic prayer institution), NOT a conventional Hindu temple — keep-or-drop decision needed. Ekasarana Dharma rejects idol worship; the Guru Asana holds the Bhagavata scripture without an idol. Founded by Srimanta Sankardev at his birthplace Bordowa (Alipukhuri), Nagaon district; the first Than/Namghar of the Ekasarana tradition. Founding date disputed: 1468 (Wikipedia, age-19 account) vs 1494 (Assam Info/CCS, post-pilgrimage account); full complex (Kirtanghar, Manikut, Cari-Hati) by 1509. Sankardev later left amid Kachari disturbances; the site was deserted and rediscovered by Kanaklata. Split into Narowa and Salaguri satras over ownership disputes, reunified as 'Bordowa Than' in 1958. A Rs 227 crore redevelopment (Mahapurush Srimanta Sankardeva Avirbhav Kshetra) was inaugurated in December 2025.

name: Bordowa Satra (Sri Sri Batadrava Than)
town_description: Bordowa (Batadrava) is a village in Nagaon district, Assam, about 16 km from Nagaon town. It is best known as the birthplace of the 15th-16th century Vaishnavite saint Srimanta Sankardev and the seat of the Batadrava Than.
tradition: Ekasarana Dharma (Assamese Neo-Vaishnavite satra institution; not an idol temple)
